video_title: James Harden said he had a GOOD series 👀 and does Donovan Mitchell sign an extension 👀

quotes.speaker: James Harden
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's self-assessment after a 4-0 series loss
quotes.excerpt: genuinely I do feel like we are the better team. But, you know, series wise, it didn't show it
quotes.quote: I can't even answer that question honestly. You know what I mean? Like, yeah, it was 4-0 but I don't think we gave we had a chance as far as our best shot from a standpoint of circumstances. You know, obviously they just they dominated us 4-0, but I don't know if I can necessarily answer that question. Just because genuinely I do feel like we are the better team. But, you know, series wise, it didn't show it, so it's a tough question to answer.

quotes.speaker: James Harden
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's individual performance and role in the system
quotes.excerpt: defensively been extremely solid, offensively, getting guys shots and fitting into a system that was already in place
quotes.quote: I think I did pretty good. Like I don't even I don't grade myself off shot making. I think coming here was just a piece to fulfill whatever needs to be fulfilled and, defensively been extremely solid, offensively, getting guys shots and fitting into a system that was already in place. So I think I did good. Obviously I could have been better. I feel like always could be better, but I know one thing that I work extremely hard.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's role change from Houston to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: They didn't bring James Harden there to be James Harden from Houston, bro. They came there to be a bigger guard
quotes.quote: If you watch the game, they didn't bring James Harden there to be James Harden from Houston, bro. They came there to be a bigger guard that can facilitate and get guys shots. Did he get Sam Merrill shots? Did he get Strus shots? Did he make things easier for these other guys? These guys didn't make shots. Like they brought somebody there to help Don and he did his job. That's and I think he's basing it on that. I never thought they brought James Harden to be James Harden who he used to be because that's not who he is. He's older now and he don't have the same movement that he used to have when he was in Houston. Just call it what it is, bro. He's older.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland's poor shooting and defensive fatigue in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: The Cleveland Cavaliers didn't make shit. The only person that was making shots was Donovan.
quotes.quote: He got them open looks. They weren't going in. Point blank period. I think when you have Sam Merrill and Strus guarding Jalen Brunson and doing all that, it can affect the legs on the other end. Point blank period. And coming off two seven game series. And you got to guard them both ends because Josh Hart is putting pressure on you. OG is putting pressure on you. And Keldon is putting pressure on you. So these guys are not getting no time off. That's hard. They're not defenders either. You got a team full of non-defenders.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The psychological impact of losing Game 1 for Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: Don talked about it after game three loss. He's still talking about game one.
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, bro, you can try to fight human nature. You can try to fight the wherewithal to not give up. Game three they didn't give up until the very end. Like, damn, bro. Don talked about it after game three loss. He's still talking about game one. Once I heard that, I said, oh, they're still thinking about it. Of course you are. You're up 22 with seven. You can't lose that one. You can't lose that one. Because human nature for the Knicks, pressure goes back on them. They can't lose game two. And they win that one. Cleveland, you're going to Cleveland on a whole different type of mindset. We did our job. We got one in New York. Now we can go even if you lose game three, just like the Spurs did. Game four, you still got something to play for because it's only 2-1. Then you got a chance to go back to New York going 2-2. Game one, that was game one series was over.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell's commitment to Cleveland and unfinished business
quotes.excerpt: I have no doubt this group can get there. But, you know, reports are going to be reports, people are going to be people.
quotes.quote: I think there's a lot to that. I love it here. I don't know how else to say it. I've said it before I signed the other extension. I love it here. And I have no doubt this group can get there. But, you know, reports are going to be reports, people are going to be people. But I've said the same thing. We have unfinished business. It's great energy to see the city, when we got to the conference finals, just to feel like that's amazing. And that's why getting swept like this sucks because, you know, you feel what like even driving in, people are going crazy. I love that. I love that about this place, man. It's the city deserves a ring and we just we just got to keep going.

quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland's missing pieces and roster construction
quotes.excerpt: I don't think James is a one, bro.

text_blocks.text: I think they also what they're missing, my fault, Hong, is a point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: No, I think James is a point guard.

text_blocks.text: I don't think James is a one, bro.

text_blocks.text: Why not?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You can't play James, Donovan.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You got James and you got Donovan. They kind of like very similar.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Championship teams need two-way players to succeed
quotes.excerpt: If you don't have two-way players, you're not going to win.
quotes.quote: Who are the last championship teams in the last five years? OKC, Celtics, Nuggets, Warriors, Bucks. That's five. Think about all the two-way guys just from those teams. You got Jrue Holiday on both two teams. You had Khris Middleton on the Milwaukee Bucks. P.J. Tucker, right? With the Milwaukee Bucks. You had Giannis, of course. So then you go to Denver, you had LeBron, you had Aaron Gordon, you had Bruce Brown, you had and then you had your two killers. KCP was on the team who was shooting the piss out the ball that year and guarding your best defender. So then you go to Golden State, you had Andrew Wiggins, you had Draymond Green, you got Stephen Curry, the best shooter ever lived in the then you had Jordan Poole who came out of nowhere. I mean, you had Gary Payton, you had Andre Iguodala, he didn't even play that much. But Andrew Wiggins was All-Star that year. So then the next year you got Boston. Pick your poison. Pick a player. I don't give a fuck who you pick over there. And then you got OKC a plethora of two-way. Pick your poison over there. And guess who's still in the playoffs right now that has a chance to win it? The Spurs. Pick your poison. All them niggas guard. All them niggas can make shots.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland's salary cap situation and lack of space for LeBron
quotes.excerpt: They don't have enough money, bro. They don't have cap space.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Can we go look at it? The reported salary cap is supposed to be 165. Where you can probably where you sign a player. We got 50, 50. That's 101 right there between those two. Jarrett Allen takes another 26. That brings you to 126, 127. Max Strus is on the hook for about 17. So that brings you to 144. 14 from Dennis Schroder. That brings you to 160. 9 mil for Max. You're already at 160. Max Strus is about to get traded. What are we talking about? If he gets traded, sure, but I'm just saying, you already have 150, 170. Dwyane Wade gone. All those guys that make from. But they already have 170 committed before you get past that line. And if you add James Harden at 20, that puts you at like 190, 180.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: So wait a minute. You think you think they're not going to make a move to bring LeBron James?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: If they can, sure, but I'm just saying their roster will change quite a bit. I'm just saying you said they have a lot of cap space. They don't have cap space.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron's potential impact on Cleveland and cap space issues

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Dwyane Wade, does LeBron make this team better? Cleveland?

text_blocks.speaker: Dwyane Wade
text_blocks.text: You want me to hang up? Hong says a lot of shit that doesn't make sense.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: He didn't say that. What I said is Theo said there's cap space. I said there's no cap space. They're going to have to make cap space.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: They're going to have to make cap space for sure. They got a lot of money on the books.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: The lasting impact of Cleveland's Game 1 loss on the series
quotes.excerpt: that game one cost them everything. I feel like they could never get past losing that game.

text_blocks.speaker: Dwyane Wade
text_blocks.text: I heard you all talking about that game one and I mean, man, that game one cost them everything. I feel like I feel like Theo, like you said, like they they just they could never get past losing that game. Like it was just.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Nigga, we couldn't get past it. That's true. That's true. You all three couldn't get past it because you all losing bread off of that. Facts. You all wanted that 50 the next day. I turned off the game, went to sleep thinking I had the 50 in my pocket.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Me too, Dwyane Wade. Damn. We were at we were at dinner with Peter and I'm like, oh, I'm going to get 50. And then it was a game one.
